decision: Reprimand (Driving) This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season. Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence and Car 24 crossed the line at pit exit. The Stewards issued a Reprimand (driving) which is the standard penalty for this infringement. We did not consider this infringement to be dangerous as it was right at the end of the pit exit line and there was no other car nearby.
fact: Car 24 crossed the white line at Pit Exit.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 6 of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Notes (item 11, document 36).
